research.topic: Schizophrenia – Myths & How to Support a Friend or Family Member
verified: Stigma may negatively affect treatment adherence and increase relapse risk.

sources.title: Challenging the public stigma of mental illness: a meta-analysis of outcome studies.

research.hook: Wish I knew earlier that saying ‘just relax, you’ll be fine’ can actually push a friend with schizophrenia further away… Here’s what really helps.
research.tip: Ask, don’t assume – say “Hey, I’ve noticed you’ve seemed a bit stressed lately. Want to talk? I’m here to listen.”

data.title: Schizophrenia Myths: Dost ko Kaise Support Kare
data.title_en: Schizophrenia Myths: How to Support a Friend

scenes.text: Kya ‘just relax’ dosti ko door karta hai?
scenes.text_en: Does saying ‘just relax’ push a friendship away?
scenes.text_hi: क्या ‘just relax’ दोस्ती को दूर करता है?

scenes.text: Schizophrenia mein soch aur feelings kabhi kabhi alag lagti hain.
scenes.text_en: In schizophrenia, thoughts and feelings can sometimes feel separate.
scenes.text_hi: Schizophrenia में सोच और feelings कभी कभी अलग लगती हैं।

scenes.text: Myth: Unko sirf ‘mind games’ se theek kiya ja sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: Myth: They can be fixed just with ‘mind games’.
scenes.text_hi: Myth: उनको सिर्फ ‘mind games’ से ठीक किया जा सकता है।

scenes.text: Fact: Ye ek medical condition hai, professional help zaroori hai.
scenes.text_en: Fact: It’s a medical condition, professional help is essential.
scenes.text_hi: Fact: यह एक medical condition है, professional help ज़रूरी है।

scenes.text: Stigma unki treatment adherence ko kam karta hai, relapse risk badhata hai.
scenes.text_en: Stigma reduces treatment adherence and raises relapse risk.
scenes.text_hi: Stigma उनकी treatment adherence को कम करता है, relapse risk बढ़ाता है।

scenes.text: Aap kya kar sakte ho? Pehle unse puchho, assume mat karo.
scenes.text_en: What can you do? First ask them, don’t assume.
scenes.text_hi: आप क्या कर सकते हो? पहले उनसे पूछो, assume मत करो।

scenes.text: Say: ‘Maine notice kiya tum stress mein ho, baat karna?’
scenes.text_en: Say: ‘I’ve noticed you’re stressed, want to talk?’
scenes.text_hi: Say: ‘मैंने notice किया तुम stress में हो, बात करना?’

scenes.text: Unko suno bina judge kiye, unki feelings ko validate karo.
scenes.text_en: Listen without judging, validate their feelings.
scenes.text_hi: उनको सुनो बिना judge किए, उनकी feelings को validate करो।

scenes.text: Agar wo therapy chahe, unhe gently encourage karo.
scenes.text_en: If they want therapy, gently encourage them.
scenes.text_hi: अगर वो therapy चाहे, उन्हें gently encourage करो।

scenes.text: Yaad rakho: stigma ko todna, support dena, assumptions nahi.
scenes.text_en: Remember: break stigma, give support, no assumptions.
scenes.text_hi: याद रखो: stigma को तोड़ना, support देना, assumptions नहीं।

scenes.text: Aaj se ek friend ko pucho, ‘Kaisa feel kar rahe ho?’
scenes.text_en: From today, ask a friend, ‘How are you feeling?’
scenes.text_hi: आज से एक friend को पूछो, ‘कैसा feel कर रहे हो?’

data.description: A quick myth‑busting reel on schizophrenia, showing how stigma harms treatment and giving three simple steps to support a friend or family member without judgment.
